identity.title: NMP2 Licensee Event Report 2020-001, Manual Scram due to an Electro­ Hydraulic Control Fluid Leak on the Turbine Control System

cause.proximate_text: inadequate procedure quality that prevented the performance of appropriate preventative maintenance resulting in cyclic fatigue failure of the EHC line. The Main Turbine Electro-Hydraulic Control Accumulator Preventive Maintenance was inadequate in the identification of degraded Turbine Control Valve (TCV) accumulator performance in 2016 and 2018, resulting in missed opportunities to replace or rebuild the degraded accumulators' bladders.

nodes.display_name: 3/4-inch stainless steel EHC supply tube (upstream of 2TMB-V157D)

nodes.description: Degraded Turbine Control Valve accumulator performance identified in 2016 and 2018 surveillance but not corrected due to inadequate PM procedure.
Accumulator bladders eventually failed, causing increased EHC system pressure pulsations and excessive vibrations.

nodes.display_name: Increased EHC pressure pulsations and excessive vibration
nodes.description: Failed accumulator bladders led to increased pressure pulsations and excessive vibrations in the EHC system.

nodes.display_name: Cyclic fatigue failure of EHC supply line tube
nodes.description: Excessive vibration caused cyclic fatigue failure of the 3/4-inch stainless steel EHC supply tube upstream of MSV 1D isolation valve.
Failed tube resulted in an un-isolable leak of EHC fluid, rapidly lowering EHC reservoir level.

nodes.display_name: Manual reactor scram / low reactor water level EOP entry
Replace failed EHC line and Turbine Control Valve accumulators
Revise Main Turbine EHC Accumulator preventive maintenance procedure
